CONTAINERS ARE RESTARTING.

Alert on restart RATE, not on total count - a total count alerts forever after one historical restart, and gets muted.

First command:
  kubectl get pods -n orders
  kubectl describe pod POD -n orders | grep -A6 'Last State'

Read the exit code:
  137  = SIGKILL. OOMKilled, or grace period expired -> TROUBLESHOOTING.md section 4
  143  = SIGTERM. Liveness probe failure or eviction  -> TROUBLESHOOTING.md section 6
  other = the application chose to exit             -> TROUBLESHOOTING.md section 3

CAVEAT: a supervisor or ASGI server can rewrite the application's exit code.
Only 137 and 143 (which originate outside the process) are fully reliable.

Then:
  kubectl logs POD -n orders --previous    <-- the crash reason is HERE

Capture evidence before fixing - a second restart overwrites --previous logs:
  ./scripts/collect-logs.sh -n orders
